label: VERIFIED
extraction: AI Tools for Obsidian (ACP) Detail: Built on Agent Client Protocol (ACP) for standardized agent communication. 74 stars, Apache-2.0. Features: Parallel Sessions (4 side-by-side agent sessions, numbered tabs, busy indicator), Message Queueing (type while agent responds, queued messages send automatically), Quick Prompts (saved prompts fired from chips or ! search, reference notes with @[[wikilinks]]), Direct Agent Integration (Claude Agent, Gemini CLI in side panel), Image Attachments (paste/drag-drop), Note Mention Support (active note auto-included). Demo video available. Brings CLI agents directly into Obsidian vault.
